visible_text: 設定画面を開けませんでした
プライバシーとセキュリティ

observation.happening: A macOS-style warning toast reports that opening the system settings deep-link failed, with a breadcrumb showing the intended destination and a retry button.
observation.most_important: The retry button "もう一度開く" — the only recovery path offered.
observation.next_action: Click "もう一度開く" to retry, or dismiss with ×.
anomalies: A separate circular waveform/bar-chart icon floats to the right of the toast with a visible gap, unclear if it belongs to the same component
The breadcrumb separator between the two settings-path labels is very thin/low-contrast

ai_look: disconnected circular badge with no label reads like a leftover placeholder element
3072.why: The floating circular icon is compositionally disconnected from the toast body (visible gap, no clear grouping) — a concrete geometry defect visible in the image.

observation.happening: A dark toast confirms a screenshot was captured and reassures that it's only sent to Claude when the user asks.
observation.most_important: The privacy reassurance subtext about when the screenshot is sent.

3680.why: Clean, well-balanced dark toast with consistent padding and clear icon/title/subtitle/close alignment, but it's a simple single-purpose notification without a distinguishing detail that pushes it to top tier.

visible_text: Astra を自動で見つけられません
Astra をオンにしてください

observation.happening: A warning toast states the app couldn't auto-detect "Astra" in the screen-recording permission list and instructs manual enabling.
observation.most_important: The blue "システム設定を開く" CTA button.
observation.next_action: Click the button to open System Settings, or dismiss.
anomalies: Same detached circular waveform icon floating to the right with a gap, as in 3072
Button label sits tight against the pill edges

ai_look: same detached circular badge pattern repeated across variants, suggesting a reused templated component without refined icon placement
3A79.why: Repeats the same disconnected-icon composition flaw seen in 3072, directly visible in the image.

visible_text: AstraDbg を再起動すると使えます

observation.happening: Native macOS System Settings Screen Recording panel with a custom coaching tooltip pointing at the just-toggled AstraDbg row, telling the user to restart the app.
observation.most_important: The tooltip "AstraDbgを再起動すると使えます" indicating the toggle needs a restart to take effect.
observation.next_action: Restart AstraDbg for the permission to apply.
anomalies: A red "1" badge is cropped at the top-left corner, only partially visible
The blue focus ring around the row and the tooltip border use slightly different blue tones

3E91.why: Leverages native macOS chrome for a high baseline, and the coaching tooltip is functionally sound, but the cropped badge and mismatched blue tones keep it short of fully polished.

visible_text: 画面収録が未許可です
Astra をオンにしてください

observation.happening: A warning toast states screen recording permission isn't granted and instructs enabling Astra in System Settings.
observation.most_important: The CTA button "システム設定を開く".
observation.next_action: Click the button to jump to System Settings, or dismiss.
anomalies: Identical detached circular icon to the right again
Near-identical to 3072 and 3A79 in structure — three overlapping failure-state toasts rather than one consolidated design

ai_look: templated repetition across near-duplicate error toasts instead of one consolidated state
91BE.why: Same recurring detached-icon geometry flaw, plus redundant near-duplicate messaging visible once compared against the other toasts in this set.

visible_text: 画面収録を設定できました

observation.happening: A success toast confirms screen recording was configured.
observation.most_important: The checkmark plus confirmation text as the terminal success state.
observation.next_action: Dismiss via ×; no further action required.
anomalies: Circular icon to the right again present (teal-toned this time), still with a visible gap from the toast body
No subtext under the title, unlike the warning variants, leaving proportionally more empty space

ai_look: reuses the same floating circular badge across every state regardless of relevance
AF8F.why: The cleanest of the toast family — single line, clear success state — but still carries the unexplained separate circle badge and a generic toast look, keeping it below top tier.
